name: Co Czyni Nas Wyjątkowymi
source:
One day, Ethan accidentally got involved in starting a school newspaper. Together with Layla, Claire, and Scarlett, they start a new adventure. Your choices will determine if they’ll make it a success and how their relationships will look like.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1263110/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一天，伊森意外卷入了创办校报的计划。他将与蕾拉、克莱尔和斯嘉丽一同展开新的冒险。你的选择，将决定他们能否成功，也将影响彼此的关系。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1263110/]Steam[/url]]
